previous_episode_state.title: The Memory of Tomorrow
previous_episode_state.episode_goal: Force Mara to trust Ilyan after their supernatural costs collide during an impossible rescue.
previous_episode_state.synopsis: Paramedic Mara Velez hears a dying passenger's final memory and sees herself murder an unknown man tomorrow. The man, Ilyan Vale, arrives and reveals that he can save the passenger only by surrendering an unpredictable personal memory. Mara chooses the victim's life over her need for answers, and Ilyan succeeds—but forgets meeting her. The revived passenger then produces a future-dated video of Mara stabbing Ilyan, proving someone has already begun engineering the murder.

character_states.name: Mara Velez
character_states.motivation: Save lives without letting the dead consume her identity.

character_states.name: Ilyan Vale
character_states.motivation: Stop a supernatural killer before she forgets why she began hunting him.

character_states.name: Daniel Cho
character_states.motivation: Use his last breath to warn Mara about the approaching killer.

previous_episode_state.final_scene_outcome: Daniel survives with a future-dated murder video, while Ilyan no longer remembers meeting Mara.
previous_episode_state.final_turning_point: The video reveals Mara killing Ilyan at the exact moment Ilyan fails to recognize her.
previous_episode_state.next_episode_question: Why does Daniel remember Mara killing Ilyan tomorrow, and who has already erased part of Ilyan's past?
